page.layout: Running head centred at top ("PARS PRIMA.") with page number 65 at top right. Below it, two round portrait medallions side by side, each with its inscription around the edge. Below them, one full-width text block of two paragraphs, justified, with the first paragraph starting at the top. At the lower right, the gathering signature "Ff". At the bottom centre, a woodcut ornament with no text (not transcribed). No margin notes.

main_text.l: ISRA NADAB R.
R. ISRAEL. BAASA
NADAB filius Ieroboam successit patri in regno Israël,
anno secundo regni Asa, Regis Iuda: hic impius, genuina pa-
tris proles, non diu imperauit: occisus est à Baasa anno tertio
Asa Regis Iudæ:& regnum eius occupauit homicida ille Baasa.
Vide tertium librū Regum,cap.14. & 15.imperauit anno à con-
dito mundo 2992. ante Christum natum 970.
BAASA occiso Nadab,regnauit super Israëlem annos 24.
homicidio regnum assecutus, homicidia iterum perpetrauit:
nam omnem familiam Ieroboam interfecit. fuit huic bellum
cum Asa, nam ascenderat Baasa in Iudam, & Rama muro cin-
gebat, vt ne quis à regno Iudæ in regnum Israël penetrare pos-
set: quamobrem perterrefactus Asa, missis muneribus opem
Ben-adab Regis Syriæ implorauit: vti dictum iam à me supra
est in Asa. Tandem Iehu prædixit ipsi Baasæ sui ipsius suorum-
que ruinam ob idololatriam, sicuti familiæ Ieroboam. successit
Baasæ Ela filius. incepit regnare Baasa anno mundi 2992. ante
Christum natum 970. nempe eodem anno de quo supra in
Nadab. Vide lib.3.Reg.15.& 16.cap.Iosephlib.Antiq.8.cap.12.

page.notes: The medallion inscriptions are read from the woodcut: left "ISRA" and "NADAB R." (the "ISRA" end is cut off by the edge, possibly ISRAEL), right "R. ISRAEL." and "BAASA". The reference "Iosephlib.Antiq.8.cap.12." has no clear space after "Ioseph" in the scan; it may read "Ioseph. lib." Possible printing error: "Iosephlib" is written without a space. The ornament at the bottom centre is a woodcut tailpiece with no text.
